scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run tsc && bun run test && bun run build
scripts.icons: for size in 16 32 48 128; do rsvg-convert -w $size -h $size icons/icon.svg -o icons/icon-$size.png; done
scripts.package: bun run check && rm -rf release && mkdir -p release && zip -r -X -q "release/recording-border-for-google-meet-$(node -p "require('./manifest.json').version").zip" manifest.json _locales dist icons/*.png
scripts.store:images: for image in store/images/*/*.svg; do rsvg-convert "$image" -o "${image%.svg}.png"; done
